item.title: 3D Printer Filament Pla 1Kg
item.description: This SKU (YCS-DGO-014) is sourced from audited Chinese factories with AQL 2.5 quality control and DDP shipping to 50+ countries. YCS-DGO-014 3D Printer Filament Pla 1Kg — 1 kg vacuum-sealed PLA 3D printer filament spool at $5.83 USD , MOQ 1 . Nominal diameter 1.75 mm (±0.03 mm 3σ over 96 m sample length), roundness ≤ 0.02 mm, 1.24 g/cm³ density. Tensile strength 59 MPa (ASTM D638), flexural modulus 3.3 GPa, heat deflection 58 °C. Green opaque (RAL 6005); compatible with Prusa, Bambu, Creality, Ender, Anycubic, Snapmaker 0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 mm nozzles; 190–220 °C nozzle / 50–70 °C bed. No brittle fracture seen on>20,000 spools shipped (≤ 0.4 % warp rate).
